LEADERS, 2026-10-30 close
The strongest stocks I follow, to ride for weeks. Prices are from that close; buy at the next open (5:30 pm Kuwait).
Strongest over 6 months: REPL +604%, MRNA +389%, CDNA +307%, ABCL +177%, OKTA +175%.

NEW TO BUY (1)
ABCL closed 12.27, up 177% in 6 months
  BUY 12.27 to 12.70. If it opens higher, skip it
  STOP 9.69 (21.0% below). I raise it as the stock climbs
  SELL when it closes under the stop or under its 50 day average (now ~11.78). No fixed target: let it run
  next earnings 2026-11-09, in 9 days

TXG: closed under its 50 day average. In at 71.39, closed 70.11 (-1.8%)
TEAM: closed under its trailing stop 196.62. In at 220.18, closed 191.65 (-13.0%)

STILL RIDING (2)
MRNA: in at 196.43 on 2026-10-08, closed 221.75 (+12.9%), stop now 192.78
CDNA: in at 61.88 on 2026-10-08, closed 87.42 (+41.3%), stop now 72.71

Strong but left out: REPL (lottery-like: +23% in one day in the last month).

Rule in use: strength over 6 months, stop 3 normal daily moves under the close. I re-test 9 versions every night; 7 pass tonight.
Past test, 80 large stocks together since 2016, five held at a time: 467 trades, 37% won. Winners averaged +13.4%, losers -5.6%, all trades +1.54% each after costs (S&P 500 over the same days +1.05%). Typical hold 16 sessions. Earlier half 2.29%, later half 0.79% a trade. Whole account about 13% a year against 13% for the S&P 500. Best trade +146%, worst -27%.
Caution: the test list is today’s well-known companies, which flatters the past. The paper record below, counted from now on, is the honest test.
FAIR TEST (whole market, collapsed stocks included, 2021-10-12 to 2026-10-19): this version PROVISIONALLY PROMISING. It passed in the newer half at the 0.8% cost. Live paper trades must still confirm it.
Paper record since this list started: 5 finished, 20% won, average -15.9% a trade after costs. Winners averaged +0.6%, losers -20.1%. Profit factor 0.01 (above 1 means it earns). Best +0.6%, worst -38.3%. Deepest fall of the paper account 15.9%. Under 20 finished trades: too few to judge. If every entry had been filled at the dearest price inside its buy range: average -19.5% a trade.
Costs in these figures: 0.8% a trade (3 USD + 3 USD fees on a 1,000 USD buy plus the spread), the same cost the fair test uses. Trades finished before 18 Oct 2026 were counted at 0.4%.
If you buy one, tell me: bought SYMBOL price. I will then trail its stop for you.
